hero.name: Darth Vader
hero.specialAbility:
FORCE GRIP
At the start of your turn, you may discard a card to deal damage equal to its BOOST value to a fighter in Darth Vader's zone.

sidekick.name: Sidekick
sidekick.quote:
"Now, release your anger!
     Only your hatred can destroy me!"

cards.duringText: If you are attacking, the value of this card is 4 instead.
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.
cards.title: Dark Lord's Presence

cards.afterText:
If you won the combat, your opponent chooses whether you both draw a card or both discard a card.
If you lost the combat, you make that choice instead.
cards.title: Inner Conflict

cards.afterText: If you won the combat, deal 1 damage to each fighter adjacent to Darth Vader.
cards.title: Surrounded by Fear

cards.immediateText: If Darth Vader is adjacent to the opposing fighter, the opposing fighter may not leave their space this turn.
cards.title: There is No Escape

cards.afterText: If you dealt 2 or more combat damage, your opponent discards 2 random cards.
cards.title: All Too Easy

cards.afterText: If you won the combat, you may choose a card in your discard pile and shuffle it into your deck.
cards.title: By the Emperor's Will

cards.duringText: You may spend an additional action to make this card's value 9 instead.
cards.title: I Have You Now

cards.duringText: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. Increase the value of this card by twice that card's BOOST value.
cards.title: Form V Mastery

cards.afterText: Draw cards equal to the amount of combat damage you took.
cards.title: Power of the Dark Side

cards.basicText:
Move Darth Vader up to 4 spaces. He may move through opposing fighters.
Then, if he is adjacent to an opposing fighter, gain 1 action.
cards.title: Hunt Down and Destroy

cards.basicText: Place Darth Vader in a starting space. Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action.
cards.title: Meditation Chamber
